decisions.reason: With proven adoption by the UK Home Office and connections to over 30 government APIS schemes, this option has largely resolved its uncertainty in favour of value, so it warrants continued commitment.

Demand for travel health requirements has faded since the pandemic and no results are reported, but the API costs little to keep on the market and fits the travel-data portfolio, so the option stays open for now.

Document and travel verification sits close to the firm's core aviation security offer and is low-cost to maintain, and the firm has already pruned weaker options, so it remains a plausible growth option.
